How to race

Choose Conserve, Rhythm or Push to manage pace. Move lanes to pass; a horse ahead can block you. A blue slipstream saves stamina. Choose a race plan: the Closer gets a late advantage with reserve left; Breakaway gains early pace at a stamina cost; Slipstream improves drafting. Conserve or draft to build Resolve, which makes your single 4.5-second Skybreak stronger. Soft turf favours power, and drafting shields you from the headwind. Burst when you have space. The outside of a bend costs distance.

Keyboard: A/D or ←/→ change lanes, 1/2/3 choose pace, Space bursts, C changes camera, P pauses. Touch controls are below the track. Practice is free, with no prizes or farm-energy deduction.
